node_definition.done_when:
After picker-pick-within-bound (merged on main), reckon/crew/picker/lane_context.py _expected_wait counts every live local worker. It does so by reading, through run_time_profile, the whole ledger of each distinct foreign project that has a live local worker. That run measured one such read at 635 ms, which put a pick at about 2.0 s, and its review measured 0.6–3.4 s per foreign project on this GPFS. Up to five projects (imas-ambix, imas-codex, imas-efit, nova, reckon) share the local lane, so a busy lane can push a pick back past its 5 s dispatch bound, and nothing tests that.

Required behaviour:
1. The expected-wait figure keeps counting every live local worker. Do not narrow it back to the pick's own project.
2. A pick's cost no longer scales with the number of live foreign projects. Reuse a run-time profile per project across picks, keyed on something that changes when that project's ledger changes, such as the ledger directory's mtime or the newest run file. Alternatively, derive the foreign contribution from data the pick already holds or from the lane document. Choose by measurement and record why.
3. Add a test, tests/test_picker_foreign_wait_is_bounded.py. With four foreign projects, each holding a live local worker, a pick must read each foreign ledger at most once across two consecutive picks, with no change to any ledger. Ledger reads are counted with a monkeypatched loader.
4. Measure a real pick with the current live foreign projects, and record the per-phase figures from tool output in docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/picker-foreign-wait-bounded.html. Also remove the truncated duplicate sentence beginning "Gate. Base arm and head arm run the picker test files with" in docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/picker-pick-within-bound.html, near line 110.

Gate: tests/test_picker_foreign_wait_is_bounded.py, tests/test_picker_pick_within_bound.py, tests/test_picker_return_time.py if present, tests/test_run_time_profile.py and the other tests/test_picker*.py files. Run with the main checkout's .venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider, one log for base and one for head under the run directory, judged by delta.
